Kornitzer Capital Management Inc. KS reduced its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.3% during the third quarter, HoldingsChannel reports. The firm owned 400,398 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 9,433 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 1.1% of Kornitzer Capital Management Inc. KS’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 10th largest holding. Kornitzer Capital Management Inc. KS’s holdings in Apple were worth $61,709,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
